verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents built-in AI that takes delegated work. Accounting AI runs prompts on the general ledger, and AI Close uses AI agents to reconcile accounts and review transactions. There is also an in-app "ask AI" button, plus a marketing promise that busywork described once is done automatically and reviewed by the user. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and in-depth docs on the assistant's scope, the range of tasks it can take, and its limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Hand off the busywork. Finding software subscriptions, matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
